title: Vendored NumPy CPU probe is misclassified as an application CLI command
reasoning: The detected entrypoint is a NumPy distutils CPU feature check source under a packaged Python runtime, not a WindieOS-owned CLI surface. Treating it as a clawpatch semantic feature would route review, testing, or patch generation into vendored environment contents where changes are likely to be overwritten by dependency/runtime rebuilds and are not part of the product API.
recommendation: Exclude vendored Python runtime and site-packages CPU check sources from CLI feature detection, or classify them as third-party build probes instead of product commands.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests are included for feature discovery or vendored-path exclusion, so the classifier can surface this probe as an owned CLI feature unchecked.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a feature-discovery regression that scans a fixture path under frontend/python-runtime/lib/python3.11/site-packages/numpy/distutils/checks and asserts C files with main() there are excluded from product CLI-command features.
minimumFixScope: Feature discovery/classification rules for vendored runtime paths; no change should be made to the NumPy source file itself.

history.note: Excluded vendored frontend/python-runtime dependency probe from WindieOS-owned review scope
